texts.zh:
[From.GetName]少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

或许再靠近些扫描这个星系会得到更多信息。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but the theory stands disproven by reality. We have marked the missing planetoids positions on our star charts.

Perhaps a closer scan of the system could reveal more.

label.zh: 边境星系出现异常「失踪的行星」
label.en: The anomaly “The Missing Planets” appears in the border system

texts.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
texts.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

sections.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
sections.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

texts.zh:
那些星球是被移动了！

我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]星系探测到的异常超空间航道都连接着我们认为应该存在星球的位置。在研究了这些怪异的航道后，我们发现它们都通向同一个地方。一个叫做达恰的恒星系，本以为是无法到达的，但如果把这些狭窄的超空间航道合并起来，我们就能送一艘科研船过去。
texts.en:
The planets were moved!

The abnormal hyperlanes we detected in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system were each tethered to where we previously had expected to discover worlds. After studying these strange lanes, we realize they all lead to the same place. A star system called Dacha, which was thought unreachable, yet if we were to combine all these slender hyperlanes, we could pass a science ship through.

label.zh: 找到超空间航道通往何处！
label.en: Find out where the hyperlanes lead!
Do we really want to know?

label.zh: 异常揭示后，进入哈宾特母星系
label.en: After the anomaly reveals them, enter the Habinte home system

texts.zh:
围绕着[From.GetName]星系三颗恒星的每颗行星都是生态天堂，即盖亚星球，每一颗都能维持有机生命。由于这些星球上没有污染，起初我们认为它们可能无人居住。然而在进行了更深入的扫描后，我们在每颗星球上都发现了横亘整颗星球的大型城市。

更奇怪的是，似乎只有环绕中心恒星的行星是属于这个星系的。其他的恒星则由来自贺利托和其他更遥远的星系的行星环绕。
texts.en:
Orbiting each of the three stars in the [From.GetName] system are ecological paradises, Gaia worlds, each capable of sustaining organic life. Initially, we thought these might be uninhabited, given the lack of pollution. Yet after performing deeper scans we discovered large sprawling cities spanning each planet from end to end.

Stranger still, it seems like only the central star has planets originally from this system. The others are orbited by planets from Helito and other, more remote systems.

label.zh: 检测到极高密度的有机生命。
label.en: EXTREME CONCENTRATION OF ORGANIC LIFE DETECTED.

label.zh: 检测到极高密度的有机生命。
label.en: EXTREME CONCENTRATION OF ORGANIC LIFE DETECTED.

label.zh: 有了[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，那些星球会变得更好。
label.en: Those worlds would look better with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on them.
Build an observation station (hidden 5025, 60 days later)

label.en: If they are invaded or bombarded (hidden 5034/5035)

title.zh: 遭遇哈宾特统一星球国

texts.zh:
调查一颗新的盖亚星球通常是一个重大事件，但它将成为[Root.GetName]的船员在未来几个月里的例行公事。这些星球包含着一些非常奇怪的[Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，它们显然还没有实现宇宙飞行，但它们的可再生能源生产可以媲美我们最高效的反应堆。

更奇怪的是资源的平均分配。每颗星球都有生存所需的一切，这应该是不可能的。我们看到只在一颗星球出产的货物抵达另一颗星球，却没有一艘运输船起飞。
texts.en:
Surveying a new Gaia world is usually a momentous event but for the crew of the [Root.GetName] it is going to become routine for the next few months. The multiple worlds house some very strange [Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural], they obviously have not achieved spaceflight yet their renewable energy production rivals our most efficient reactors.

A further oddity is the equal spread of resources. Every world has everything they need to survive, which should be impossible. We are seeing goods only produced on one planet arrive on another without a single transport ship taking flight.

label.zh: 我们要赶快建立一座观测哨站！
label.en: We need an observation outpost now!

texts.zh:
[From.solar_system.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]在某种程度上比我们更善于运用超空间航道理论。它们的每一颗星球都通过一座人造超空间航道网络相互连接。这些航道用来向其他星球运送必要的资源，如食物或建筑材料，而我们不知道它们是如何做到这一点的。

要求更多的[Root.GetScientistPlural]来研究这些星球的请求已经得到批准。虽然从它们的行星监听站的活动来看，它们应该也在观察我们。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] of [From.solar_system.GetName] are somehow more adept with hyperlane theory than we are. Every one of their worlds are linked to each other through an artificial hyperlane network. These lanes are used transport necessary resources like food or building materials to their other worlds just using planet-bound trains, and we have no idea how they did it.

A request for more [Root.GetScientistPlural] to study these worlds has been approved. Though judging by the activity at their planetary listening posts; we are not the only ones looking at aliens.

label.zh: 观测已久且发现已久：礼貌的请求（五年脉冲）
label.en: Long observed and not newly discovered: the polite request (five-year pulse)

texts.zh:
试图通过与[event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj]合作来获取超空间航道技术知识的进度一直缓慢得令人沮丧。要想像他们一样掌握局域超空间航道群，我们似乎需要花费数千年的时间来编制超空间波动的目录。我们收到了他们首席代表的新信息。

“老实说，你们在这里让我们越来越不舒服了，既然我们已经帮你们完成了来这里的目的，我们得请你们离开。我们判断你我双方的生活方式不可相容，担心你们在未来可能会觊觎我们拥有的东西。为了避免显得过于粗鲁，我们愿意送给你们一颗星球。我们会负责运输的，不用担心。”
texts.en:
The insights we have gained into hyperlane technology through our cooperation with the [event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj] has been frustratingly slow. It seems that to achieve the mastery of a local hyperlane cluster like they have, we would need to spend thousands of years cataloging hyper-fluctuations. We have received a new communication from their chief representative.

"To be honest, your presence here has been grating, so now that we have taught you what you came for, we need to ask you to leave. Having judged that our ways of life are incompatible, we worry that you might covet what we have in the future. So to prevent any feelings of ill will, we wish to offer you one of our worlds. We will handle the transportation, don't worry."

label.en: We accept, have a good life.

tooltips.zh: 太阳 X将添加到[capital_star.GetName]轨道内。
tooltips.en: Sol X will be added in orbit around [capital_star.GetName].

label.zh: 我们要夺走你们的秘密！

tooltips.zh: 侵略这些外星人，获得超空间航道的秘密。
tooltips.en: Invade the aliens to learn the secrets of the hyperlanes.

label.zh: 拒绝请求：触发入侵后果

texts.zh:
我们以为那些能够穿越星空的人不会如此原始地诉诸暴力。

请离开。
texts.en:
We thought those who could traverse the stars wouldn't be so primitive as to resort to violence.

Leave.

tooltips.zh:
我们在[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的所有舰船都在行动中失踪了。
所有通往[From.solar_system.GetName]星系的超空间航道都变得很不稳定。
tooltips.en:
All our ships in the [From.solar_system.GetName] system have gone missing in action.
All Hyperlanes to the [From.solar_system.GetName] system have become unstable.

label.zh: 再次进入已愤怒的哈宾特星系
label.en: Enter the angered Habinte system again

note.zh: 入侵/轰炸使哈宾特升级为真正的帝国并敌视你；星系封锁（solarpunk_mad）。
note.en: Invasion/bombardment turns Habinte into a real empire hostile to you; the system closes (solarpunk_mad).

texts.zh: 我们已经见识过了泛星系的真面目，并选择隐居避世。然而我们还是遭到了骚扰，你们真的想看看我们的宝藏吗？那就让你们见识一下。
texts.en: We have seen what kind of galaxy it is and chose to avoid it, yet again we are disturbed, do you really want to see our treasures? Then let us show you.

tooltips.zh: [From.GetName]星系旁边的每个星系都建立起了新的超空间航道。
tooltips.en: Every system near the [From.GetName] system has had new hyperlanes established.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

我们认为达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]与这一状况有关。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but the theory stands disproven by reality. We have marked the missing planetoids positions on our star charts.

We gather that the neighboring [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in the Dacha system are connected to this.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]少了几颗星球。

所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。

看来是过去达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造就了这一怪异的星系。然而通往那里的超空间航道却消失了。
texts.en:
[From.GetName] is missing planets.

All calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but the theory stands disproven by reality. We have marked the missing planetoids positions on our star charts.

It seems like the previously neighboring [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in the Dacha system created this strange system. Yet the hyperlane leading there has since disappeared.

summary.text:
# 哈宾特统一星球国 / Habinte Unified Worlds

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:6658-7560`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:474,801,1050-1053,1163,1956,2174,2616`；`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:713`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 哈宾特统一星球国是一个被“偷走行星”的前超光速太阳朋克文明。玩家舰队进入其边境系统（solarpunk_system_01）时按当前是否已揭示触发 5000 或 5005；进入母星系（solarpunk_system_02）触发 5015。
  The Habinte Unified Worlds are a pre-FTL solarpunk civilization whose planets were taken. A fleet entering the border system (solarpunk_system_01) fires 5000 or 5005 depending on whether it is revealed; entering the home system (solarpunk_system_02) fires 5015.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 5000「失踪的轨道」：首次进入边境系统，给系统添加“失踪的行星”异常（7级，只由 5000 添加，每国一次，`first_contact_dlc_events.txt:6661-6698`），之后再进入则出现 5005。
  5000 "Missing Orbitals": first approach to the border system; it adds the level-7 anomaly "The Missing Planets" (added only by 5000, once per empire); later entries show 5005.
- 异常唯一结果 5010「星球大盗」（权重1，`02_anomaly_categories.txt:703-715`）：探查或不探查都给物理研究；全银河首次时生成达恰（solarpunk_02）星系与前超光速的哈宾特国家（6751-6875）。之后舰队进入该星系才触发 5015。
  The anomaly's single outcome 5010 "Grand Theft Planet" (weight 1): either option gives physics research; the first time in the galaxy it spawns the Dacha (solarpunk_02) system and the pre-FTL Habinte country. A fleet entering that system then fires 5015.
- 5015「富饶世界」：首次进入母星系，物理研究奖励；亲生命起源/理想花园政体与灭绝型文明有专属选项。
  5015 "Worlds of Plenty": first entry into the home system, a physics-research reward; Life-Seeded / Idyllic Bloom civics and homicidal civics have exclusive options.
- 5020「哈宾特统一星球国相遇」：勘测其世界；建造观测站后（隐藏5025）60天后 5026「桥接世界」，哈宾特每30天获得觉醒度直到100。
  5020 "Habinte Unified Worlds Encountered": surveying their world; after building an observation station (hidden 5025) 5026 "Bridge Between Worlds" follows 60 days later, and Habinte gain awareness every 30 days up to 100.
- 入侵或轰炸他们（5034/5035）→ 5036「温和种族的愤怒」：他们在5天后升级为真正的帝国并敌视你；之后再进入其星系出现 5040「外交绝无可能」。
  Invading or bombarding them (5034/5035) -> 5036 "Anger of a Gentle Race": they become a real empire five days later and hostile to you; re-entering their system gives 5040 "Diplomacy Was Never an Option".
- 和平线：观测足够久后五年脉冲出现 5050「礼貌的请求」：a 撤出观测站并交换星球（5051），c 拒绝并触发入侵后果。
  Peaceful line: after enough observation the five-year pulse brings 5050 "Polite Request": a withdraws the outposts and swaps a planet (5051), c refuses and triggers the invasion aftermath.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 愤怒线（5036/5040）与礼貌请求线（5050）互斥地收尾；5000 与 5005 互斥。
  The anger line (5036/5040) and the polite-request line (5050) end the story exclusively; 5000 and 5005 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 5015 的第三个选项只给灭绝型文明（机械终结者/吞噬群/纯化者）；5050.a 需要哈宾特仍是原始文明。
  The third 5015 option is for homicidal civics (Terminator / Devouring Swarm / Purifiers); 5050.a needs Habinte still primitive.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：每个入口的 on_action、星旗标志（system_01/02、revealed、mad）、观测与愤怒链、5050 触发与选项。
  Checked: each entry on_action, the star flags (system_01/02, revealed, mad), the observation and anger chains, 5050 trigger and options.
- 更正：原本是 5000/5005/5015/5020/5034/5040/5050 七个孤立的单窗口故事；现合成一条，用标志衔接。
  Correction: previously seven isolated one-window stories (5000/5005/5015/5020/5034/5040/5050); now one story linked by flags.
- 说明：fircon.5026 原挂在“谁在监视监视者”的故事下，现归入本故事。
  Note: fircon.5026 hung under the "Who Watches the Watchers?" story; it now belongs here.
- 2026-10-13 协调：异常“失踪的行星”及其结果 5010 原是单独的探索故事（anomaly-solarpunk-cat，r2-mixed 审阅），现并入本故事，路线为 5000 → 异常 → 5010 → 5015。
  2026-10-13 coordination: the anomaly "The Missing Planets" and its outcome 5010 were a separate exploration story (anomaly-solarpunk-cat, reviewed by r2-mixed); they are now part of this story, routed 5000 → anomaly → 5010 → 5015.
